title: Add deterministic OpenAPI fixture matrix
summary: Added a deterministic OpenAPI fixture matrix: 14 named cases under scanner/tests/openapi/fixtures/, a harness (matrix_harness.py), a controlled oasdiff substitute (oasdiff_substitute.py), a regenerator (regenerate_fixture_matrix.py) and the deliverable test_fixture_matrix.py. Each case commits its base tree into a temporary local Git repo with a fixed identity and date, tags it `baseline`, swaps in the candidate tree, and runs the public `dogwatch check` twice. Both runs must match the checked-in expected-report.json bytes, and expected-invocation.json too where oasdiff runs. Committed as 55138bc and pushed to origin. Nothing under src/ was changed.
